items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: He had some Reliance that played music, like Bill Gowesley, Lawrence Vega... And between him and they had about two bands, two or three bands, his Reliance.

ctx.x: Was he always, he didn't play in all of them, of course, if he had more than one band, did he send somebody else out as leader, or did he appoint? Yeah, he'd go higher, higher, you see.

He had some Reliance that played music, like Bill Gowesley, Lawrence Vega, he's dead, trumpet player. His son played, too. And Chink Martin. Yes, I know Chink, he's still alive. And Pangelline, his son, used to play trumpet. And between him and they had about two bands, two or three bands, his Reliance.
What did the bands pay in those days? How much money would you make for a parade?
